purpose: Test whether any 160-step indicator separates healthy from failed arms, on a cohort LARGER than the four arms #78 used, without tuning a threshold on the arms it is evaluated on.
note: This file fixes the protocol. The outcome labels below are already-published immutable historical Hard-L1 ER values, read from published reports and never from the frozen held-out pair file. They are recorded here so the split is auditable, and no indicator value has been computed at the time this file was written.

must_have: a runnable Stage2 tree under stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_* that can execute the real trainer
a published immutable final Hard-L1 ER label in results/stage2_RQ-VAE/<arm>/stage2_metrics.json or gate.json
the frozen v2 160-step protocol applicable without editing shared trainer code
excluded: any arm whose tree cannot run the real trainer
any arm without a published final ER label
the frozen held-out pair file: read by no pilot, at any point
corrupt or missing evidence: reported as excluded rather than imputed
inclusion_rules.selection_is_not_cherry_picked: every Stage2 tree in the repository that satisfies the rules is included. No arm is chosen because of its label.

healthy_definition: published final Hard-L1 ER strictly above the frozen baseline 16.38953942232631, or equal to it because the arm IS the baseline reference
expansion_over_78: three healthy arms (r4_08 plus both baselines) against three failed, instead of one healthy against three failed

split.rule: split by arm AND mechanism family; correlated seeds of one arm may never straddle the split
split.forbidden: choosing a threshold on the calibration arms and reporting its performance on the evaluation arms as if the cohort were one sample

scale_warning: L1-only collision has a near-1 natural scale under an occupied codebook and must never be pooled with the raw three-level tuple collision. They are separate indicators with separate units.
decision_rules_preregistered: a threshold is only proposed if it is fixed on the calibration arms alone
an indicator separates the cohort only if its evaluation-arm values are strictly ordered by label with no overlap
a false positive is an evaluation arm predicted failed but published healthy; r4_08 predicted failed is the decisive one
if the cohort is too small for any arm-level bootstrap to mean anything, report UNCALIBRATABLE rather than a number
if no indicator survives on the held-out evaluation arms, the honest result is that #78's indicators do not generalize
hard_limits: no 3000-epoch Stage2 run, no Stage3 run
the frozen held-out pairs are never read
the frozen final gate stays strictly Hard-L1 ER > 16.38953942232631
a 160-step train-only indicator is never promoted to the held-out metric or to stage3_allowed
